description: Merlin, Arthur's advisor, prophet and mage: a figure born of a demon and a baptism, architect of Camelot, prisoner of his own love.

hero.hook: Son of a demon, baptized from the cradle: Merlin serves good with powers born from evil.

blocks.text: **Merlin** is the most famous magician of the Western Middle Ages. Bard, prophet, advisor to King **Arthur**: he stands on the border between the ancient Celtic world and Christian chivalry.

Its nature is paradoxical. Part of him comes from demons, the other from heaven. His story is not that of a magic show: it is the struggle of a hybrid being who chooses to serve good, until love removes him from the world.

In the poet **Robert de Boron** (12th century), the demons want to create an antichrist. A [[Incubus demon]], a spirit who unites with a sleeping woman, seduces a young pious Christian woman. The plan fails: the mother confesses and has the child baptized.

blocks.caption: Merlin, figure of the medieval mage between forest and courtyard.

blocks.text: The name “Merlin” comes from the Welsh **Myrddin**. Geoffrey of Monmouth changed the “d” to “l” to avoid a pun too close to the Latin *shit*.

The [[Baptism]] erases the curse, but leaves the powers: knowledge of the past (demonic heritage) and gift of . Merlin can shapeshift. Behind him, we find **Myrddin Wyllt**, a 6th century Welsh bard who, mad after a battle, fled into the forest of . [[Prophecy in medieval culture]] [[Celyddon]]

sections.title: The hybrid origin between demon and baptism

blocks.text: Merlin is not an illusionist. He is the guarantor of the kingdom. He helps King  take on the features of the Duke of Cornwall to join the Duchess **Igerne**. From this night **Arthur** was born. [[Utherpendragon]]

blocks.caption: Merlin guides Arthur to the throne and Camelot.

blocks.text: He raises the child in secret, orchestrates the sword in the anvil, then leads Arthur to the Lady of the Lake to obtain, whose sheath protects against mortal wounds. At **Camelot**, he designs the **Round Table** and places the [[Excalibur]], a vacant seat reserved for the purest knight. He sees the dangers coming. He also knows that destiny always passes in the end. [[Perilous Siege]]
Merlin meets his end. However, he falls in love with **Viviane**, the Lady of the Lake, near the Barenton fountain. He teaches her his most secret spells, even though he knows she will lose it.

blocks.caption: Viviane locks Merlin up: the end of the time of the magi.

blocks.text: Depending on the version, Viviane locks him in a hawthorn bush, a glass tower or a **Brocéliande** cavity. Immortal, Merlin is not dead: he sleeps outside the world.
When the knights leave for the Grail, Merlin's magic no longer has room. Its withdrawal marks the passage from the time of myths to the time of faith.

sections.title: The fall of the enchanter: love and forgetting

blocks.text: Merlin stared at the image of the old wise man: beard, staff, riddles. From him descend **Gandalf** for Tolkien and **Dumbledore** for Rowling. He is the adjuvant who knows, but cannot act in place of the hero.

Bridge between the wild forest and the court, he keeps a [[Druidic]] imprint while advising the kings. Even today, he whispers that empires are fragile, and that wisdom does not always protect oneself.
**Merlin**, born of a demon and saved by baptism, builds the destiny of **Arthur** then disappears, prisoner of **Viviane**: the lasting model of the Western enchanter.
